title: God shows no partiality in judgment
english: There is no acceptance of persons with God. Tribulation and anguish come upon every soul of a human being working evil, of the Jew first and of the Greek; but glory and honor and peace come to everyone working good (Romans 2:9-10).
translator_notes: Copy-text PG 14 (Migne) Rufinus Latin via tesseract OCR of Archive PDF; no first-edition GCS.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC Romans.
orientation: Origen is explaining Paul's teaching that God judges everyone by their deeds, Jew first and also Greek, without favoritism.

title: True Jew and circumcision of the heart
english: For it is not the one who is a Jew in the open, nor the circumcision that is in the open in the flesh; but the one who is a Jew in the hidden, and circumcision of the heart in the spirit (Romans 2:28-29). The Gentiles naturally do the things of the law—the work of the law written in their hearts (Romans 2:14-15). Glory to Christ. Amen.
translator_notes: Copy-text PG 14 (Migne) Rufinus Latin via tesseract OCR of Archive PDF; no first-edition GCS.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC Romans.
orientation: Origen is explaining Paul's teaching in Romans 2 that outward Jewish identity and physical circumcision are not what matter before God.
